look_here_first: Start with the flower architecture: a large, open, radial four-petaled primrose—usually pink to white—with 8 stamens and a conspicuous 4-lobed cross/finger-like stigma on a spreading rhizomatous plant.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: young shoots rosetted; later stems decumbent to ascending

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: large radial flowers about 25–52 mm across

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: 4 broad fan- to heart-shaped pink/white petals
